chunks: He is thiqah (reliable) in himself. However, most of those who narrate from him are weak. Among those who narrate the most from him of the weak narrators are: Amr ibn Shimr al-Ju'fi, Mufaḍḍal ibn Salih, al-Sakuni, and Munakhkhal ibn Jamil al-Asadi.
ai.seo_question: Who are the weak narrators that most frequently transmit from Jabir ibn Yazid al-Ju'fi?
ai.summary: This entry from 'Kitab al-Du'afa' (Book of the Weak) discusses Jabir ibn Yazid al-Ju'fi al-Kufi. It notes that while he is considered reliable (thiqah) on his own merit, the majority of narrators who transmit from him are considered weak, which affects the reliability of the chains of narration coming through him.

en.tashayyu: Thiqa in himself, however most of those who narrate from him are weak.  Of those who (narrate) the most from him of the weak narrators, there are: ʿAmr b. Shimr al-Juʿfī, Mufaḍḍal b. Ṣāliḥ, al-Sakūnī, and Munakhkhal b. Jamīl al-Asadī.
